hero.taglineLine2: and the immensity of the Sahara.

manifesto.manifestoEyebrow: It isn’t a getaway, it’s a journey
manifesto.quotePrefix: Some journeys take you to a place. And others take you
manifesto.aboutP1: Mujeres de Arena was born for women who feel the call to step outside the familiar, to make room for adventure and to allow themselves to live a real experience. No impossible schedules, no scripted minutes.
manifesto.aboutP2: Seven days travelling through Morocco across vibrant cities, mountains, ancestral kasbahs, valleys full of history and the immensity of the Sahara. A space to discover new landscapes, to share the road with other women and to feel again the thrill of experiencing something for the first time.
manifesto.aboutQuoteLine1: Because sometimes transformation doesn't happen in a room.
manifesto.aboutQuoteLine2: It happens on the road. In an unexpected conversation.
manifesto.aboutCaption: The journey begins when you say yes

stages.title: Seven stages, one single story
stages.desc: From the bustle of Marrakech to the immensity of the Sahara — and back. Every stage opens a new way of seeing.

sahara.text: Here time seems to stop. Distances change. And something inside us changes too. No rush. No schedules. No expectations. Only the adventure, and the privilege of being there.

night.titlePrefix: The magic that never appears in
night.p1: The immensity of the day gives way to a calm that is hard to describe. No activities. No obligations. Nothing to prove. Only the privilege of being there, of sharing the road with other women and of letting the experience do its work.
night.p2: Because some of the most important conversations of our lives happen precisely when we stop trying to force them.

hosts.heading: Vanessa & Ana
hosts.bio: We have explored and cherished the desert for years. We created 'Mujeres de Arena' not to show you Morocco through a tour bus window, but to open the door to an intimate, safe, human, and transformative voyage.
hosts.quote: The desert asks nothing of you; it simply gives you permission to be yourself.

items.q: Is it safe to travel to Morocco?
items.a: Yes. Morocco is an established tourist destination and we will travel through the country accompanied at all times by our local team and by us. The vast majority of fears disappear as soon as the experience begins.

items.q: Can I come on my own?
items.a: Absolutely. In fact, many participants travel alone. From the very first day you will be part of a small group of women who will share the adventure with you.
They will be shared, double or triple, depending on the accommodation. If you travel alone, we will take care of the room allocation so that everything is comfortable and easy.
Women of different ages and life stages. What unites us is not age, but the desire to live an authentic experience and share an unforgettable adventure.
No. It is suitable for any woman with a normal level of fitness. There will be moments of walking and activity, but no previous experience or specific training is required.

items.q: Do I need to speak English or French?
items.a: No. Throughout the journey we will be accompanied by a Spanish-speaking local guide. Many people working in tourism also speak Spanish, French or English.
A valid passport. We recommend checking its expiry date well in advance.

items.q: What if I have allergies or dietary needs?
items.a: Just let us know in advance. We will do everything we can to pass your needs on to the accommodation and restaurants included in the journey.

cards.title: Luggage
cards.text: In September it will be hot during the day and cool at night, especially in the desert. Before the trip you will receive a practical guide with a suggested packing list.

cards.title: Currency
cards.text: The official currency is the Moroccan dirham. Once there we will help you exchange money or handle anything you need.

cards.title: Internet and coverage
cards.text: On arrival we will stop to buy a local SIM card. In some desert areas the signal can be limited.

cards.title: Flights
cards.text: Each participant arranges their own ticket to Marrakech. Once your place is confirmed we will coordinate schedules and arrivals with the group.

cards.title: Passport & Visas
cards.text: A passport valid for at least 6 months beyond travel dates is required. Citizens of the EU, UK, USA, Canada, and many other nations do not require a tourist visa for stays up to 90 days.

hero.subtitle: From the bustle of Marrakech to the immensity of the Sahara — and back. Every stage opens a new way of seeing. 7 days of shared wonder reserved for 12 women.

stages.title: Marrakech · Where the Journey Begins
stages.text: Marrakech isn’t visited. It’s felt. The city welcomes us with the scent of orange blossom, the terracotta warmth of its alleyways, and the electric buzz of Jemaa el-Fnaa at dusk.
listItems: Private airport pickup at Marrakech Menara (RAK) and welcome in our boutique riad
First mint tea and welcome sisterhood introduction circle
Sunset walk through the spice-scented alleyways and souks
Traditional family dinner in an authentic patio courtyard

stages.title: Crossing the High Atlas to Aït Ben Haddou
stages.text: We climb into the clouds over the Tizi n’Tichka pass at 2,260 meters. The scenery shifts dramatically from green mountain terraces into ancient earthen kasbahs.
listItems: Scenic traverse of the dramatic Tizi n’Tichka mountain pass
Guided walking exploration of the ancient UNESCO citadel of Aït Ben Haddou
Panoramic lunch overlooking the Ounila river valley
Scenic drive toward the tranquil rose and almond valleys of Dades

stages.title: Dades Valley & The Road of Kasbahs
stages.text: Towering crimson cliffs, switchback roads carved into stone, and green ribbon oases flourishing against the arid rock. A sensory prelude before the deep desert.
listItems: Morning walk through the legendary winding Dades canyon switchbacks
Quiet photography moments at the natural geological formations
Mint tea with a local Amazigh weaving collective
Restorative evening under mountain skies at an ancestral kasbah

stages.title: Todra Cliffs & Gateway to the Dunes
stages.text: Standing between 300-meter sheer limestone cliffs before the earth flattens into vast desert plains. In the afternoon distance, the golden silhouette of Erg Chebbi rises.
listItems: Walk through the narrow canyon corridor of Todra Gorge
Traditional stroll through a historic date palm oasis
Arrival at the desert boundary town of Merzouga
First view of the towering golden dunes of the Sahara

stages.title: Erg Chebbi · Sunset Dunes & Starlit Camp
stages.text: The emotional heart of the journey. We leave modern noise behind and ride gentle camels into the sea of golden sand at sunset. At night, traditional drums under stars.
listItems: Sunset camel trek across the crests of amber dunes
Sandboarding and meditative silence on 150-meter dune peaks
Night in a luxury desert glamping camp with real beds & private bathrooms
Hypnotic Gnawa drum music around the crackling campfire under the Milky Way

stages.title: Sunrise Whispers & Living Nomad Culture
stages.text: Watching the dawn paint the dunes in soft rose, apricot, and gold. Meeting local nomadic families who share their ancestral relationship with the desert.
listItems: Dawn meditation and contemplation from the highest dune
Traditional Berber breakfast with warm bread, olive oil, and fresh date honey
4×4 desert excursion visiting nomad encampments and fossil beds
Scenic journey toward the fragrant Valley of Roses

stages.title: Valley of Roses & The Road Home
stages.text: We are no longer the same women who landed in Marrakech seven days ago. We cross the final mountain ridge carrying new perspectives, unbreakable bonds of sisterhood.
listItems: Visit to local women’s artisan rose water cooperatives
Scenic descent through the High Atlas foothills
Farewell celebration dinner & sisterhood closing circle in Marrakech
Coordinated airport transfers for your return flights

about.subtitle: Driven by curiosity, sisterhood, and the transformative magic of stepping outside the predictable patterns of daily routine.
about.storyTitle: From a Shared Journey to a Calling
about.p1: We are driven by curiosity, adventure, and those experiences that take us outside the predictable patterns of daily routine. That is how our story with Morocco began: what started as an exploratory personal journey became a landscape and culture we felt an undeniable pull to return to again and again.
about.p2: In time, we realized that this experience was too powerful to keep to ourselves. And so Mujeres de Arena was born — not as a conventional, commercial tourist package, but as an intimate, soul-stirring journey created from the heart for women who feel the call of adventure.
about.quote: “Life expands in direct proportion to one’s courage to step into the open desert.”
